description:
The Huffy Zazzle 16" Kids Bike brings playful style and everyday adventure together for young riders. With eye-catching graphics and fun accessories, this bike is built for neighborhood cruising, driveway rides, and exciting trips with friends.
The Zazzle features Huffy’s EZ Build system, designed to make bike assembly faster and simpler. With a streamlined setup process and fewer steps, parents can spend less time assembling and more time watching their rider enjoy the fun.
Training wheels provide extra stability while riders build balance and confidence. A coaster brake allows easy pedal-back stopping, while the front hand brake adds responsive control as skills grow. A handlebar basket, bell, and streamers complete the ride with fun details kids love.

components.description: Dual Brake System: Coaster brake for easy pedal-back stopping plus a front hand brake for added control as skills grow.
